abstract: We report here a case of synchronous dermoid cyst with secondary malignant tumor and uterine endometrial adenocarcinoma that responded to UFT. A 35-year-old female complained of abdominal fullness and visited our hospital. She had an abdominal mass which was newborn-head size. We performed right salpingo-oophorectomy and partial omentectomy. The pathological findings were dermoid cyst with secondary malignant transformation. After the operation she had underwent cyclic chemotherapy with CDDP, CPA, THP and 5-FU. After three cycles of chemotherapy, a uterine recurrence was suspected from her uterine endocervical smear test. Then we performed a second operation, but radical surgery was impossible due to the presence of multiple metastases to pelvic lymph nodes. The pathological findings were primary uterine endometrial adenocarcinoma, not metastasis from dermoid cyst with secondary malignant tumor. After the second operation, she was treated with oral UFT (400 mg/day), as she refused chemotherapy and radiotherapy. Two months after the start of UFT, the tumor markers were reduced remarkably, and the patient maintained good QOL throughout the treatment without serious adverse events. We conclude that UFT might be benefical in the treatment of advanced gynecologic cancer.
abstract_ja: 本症例は、悪性腫瘍を伴う類皮嚢腫および子宮内膜腺癌の同時性発生に対し、UFTが奏効した症例の報告である。35歳の女性患者が腹部膨満感を訴えて当院を受診した。新生児頭大の腹部腫瘤を認めた。右卵管卵巣摘出術と部分大網切除を施行した。病理所見は、二次性悪性腫瘍を伴う類皮嚢腫(悪性転化)であった。術後、CDDP、CPA、THP、5-FUによる周期的化学療法を施行した。3サイクルの化学療法後、子宮頸部擦過細胞診により子宮再発が疑われた。その後2回目の手術を施行したが、骨盤リンパ節への多発転移のため根治手術は不可能であった。病理所見は、類皮嚢腫の二次性悪性腫瘍からの転移ではなく、原発性子宮内膜腺癌であった。2回目の手術後、患者は化学療法および放射線療法を拒否したため、経口UFT(400 mg/日)による治療を受けた。UFT投与開始から2か月後、腫瘍マーカーは著明に低下し、重篤な有害事象もなく、患者は治療を通じて良好なQOLを維持した。進行した婦人科がんに対してUFTは有益であろうと結論した。
